# Citation Building Group

> Local SEO and citation building agency specializing in NAP consistency, Google Business Profile optimization, and business directory submissions across USA, UK, Canada, and Australia.

Citation Building Group provides comprehensive local SEO services focused on improving business visibility through strategic citation building, link building, and Google Business Profile management. The company serves businesses seeking to rank higher in local search results and attract qualified local leads.

## Key Topics

- Citation Building
- Local SEO
- NAP Consistency
- Google Business Profile
- Business Directories
- Local Search Rankings
- Directory Submission
- Google My Business
- Citation Cleanup
- Link Building
- Local Visibility
- Business Listings
- Local 3-Pack
- Domain Authority
- Mobile Optimization

## Core Services

- [Local SEO Service for Trusted Growth](https://citationbuildinggroup.com/local-seo-service): Primary local SEO service covering Google Business Profile optimization and local search ranking improvements.
- [Local Citation Building Guide](https://citationbuildinggroup.com/local-citation-building): Comprehensive guide covering local citation building best practices and NAP consistency strategies.
- [Citation Cleanup Services](https://citationbuildinggroup.com/citation-cleanup-service): Service for fixing NAP errors and correcting inconsistent business information across directories.
- [Link Building Services](https://citationbuildinggroup.com/link-building-services): Link building service focusing on high-quality backlinks and domain authority improvement.
- [GBP Posting Services](https://citationbuildinggroup.com/monthly-gmb-posting-service): Monthly Google Business Profile posting service designed to attract local leads and engagement.
